proposal.reason: The substantive changes are to reviewer-routing and approval automation policy in GitHub workflow/scripts (.github/scripts/review_automation.py, maintainer_approval.py, commit_message_squash.py, and .github/workflows/commit-message.yml): primary-vs-additional module handling, invitation withdrawal rules, approval-gated squash-preview publication, and workflow-run wiring. Other edits (WORKFLOWS.md and skill/catalog text updates) document and support the same review-process behavior rather than changing a separate PCCL runtime module.
